about: Fixed mini-suite. Never edit a task's wording or rubric once scores exist; add a new id instead. Five trials per task, trial N uses mat spot N (A-E). One point per rubric line reached in order; success = all points.
mat: A3 sheet taped to the table in front of the arm base, five spots A-E marked 10 cm apart on an arc 20 cm from the base. Head cameras fixed at eye height behind the arm, both seeing the whole mat. Room lights on, no sunlight on the mat.

tasks.setup: One 3 cm red cube on the trial's spot.
One 3 cm red cube on the trial's spot.
rubric: Block lifted 5 cm and held 3 s

tasks.instruction: Put the red block in the bowl.
tasks.setup: Red cube on the trial's spot, 15 cm bowl on the next spot clockwise (E wraps to A).

tasks.instruction: Put the blue block in the bowl.
tasks.setup: Red cube on the trial's spot, blue cube on the previous spot, bowl on the next spot clockwise.
rubric: Goes for the blue block, not the red
Blue block in the bowl, red untouched

tasks.instruction: Slide the sheet of paper to the left.
tasks.setup: One A6 card (postcard) centred on the trial's spot, long edge facing the arm.
rubric: Card stays flat (not crumpled or flipped)

tasks.instruction: Pick up the sheet of paper.
tasks.setup: One A6 card flat on the trial's spot; the Hand 1.0 target task.
rubric: Card edge lifted off the mat
Card held in the air 3 s
